title: Pies for Every Friend

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: I've baked harvest pies, and cut them into slices. There must be the same for every guest!

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Will you share the slices onto the plates? One plate for each friend coming from far away.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Share the slices so every plate has the same.

older.prompt: Share twenty slices among six plates. What about any left over?

feedback.all_good: Two slices each. Fair and square, and plenty for all!

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Six plates, six friends, from six corners of the land. I can hardly wait for Friday!

journal_line: I shared harvest pies onto plates for our friends from far away.
